slides.title: HVAC owners, first cold week of the year: would you rather...
slides.body: Pick one per slide. No skipping.

slides.label: Would you rather
slides.title: Run 14 no-heat calls in one day
slides.body: or get pulled over on call #9 in a truck with an expired registration?

slides.label: Would you rather
slides.title: Crawl through a 120° attic in July
slides.body: or explain to a property manager why the COI you sent expired in October?

slides.label: Would you rather
slides.title: Renew the contractor license 30 days early
slides.body: or renew it after it lapses and hope nobody asks for the number this week?

slides.label: Would you rather
slides.title: Hold the flashlight for the new guy
slides.body: or be the one who finds out the workers' comp policy renewal email went to the old office address?

slides.label: Save this before the rush
slides.title: Busy season is the worst time to find an expired date.
slides.body: Contractor license, liability policy and COIs, commercial auto, workers' comp, bond, every truck registration.
